monsterFluff.name: Vizir, the Boneeater
entries: Once a high priest of the temple of Ator, this vizier betrayed his goddess to attain immortality through dark practices. The dark arts transformed him into an undead creature, forced to serve the corruption he once fought against. He still wears the remains of his ceremonial robes, now tattered and stained with black mud, and his face is a mask of dried skin stretched over a skull. From his hollow eyes drips an amber, dying light.
